content: Patients must provide at least 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule an appointment without incurring a late-cancellation fee. Cancellations made within 24 hours of the scheduled time may attract a fee equivalent to 10% of the consultation charge, which will be applied as a credit against the patient's next visit. To cancel or reschedule, patients may use the clinic portal, the mobile app, or call the front desk; appointment modifications are not accepted via email or social media. In the event of a medical emergency, the late-cancellation fee is waived upon submission of relevant documentation. Repeated no-shows (three or more within a 12-month period) may result in booking restrictions until the clinic's patient liaison team reviews the account.
